text: みんなで　ここまで　およいで　くたびれた…　ほんとに　また　やるの…？

structure.jp: ここまで　およいで

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: およいで　くたびれた
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, and here the first is the cause of the second. およいで　くたびれた = 'we swam and got worn out'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a word for a group says who does it together. みんなで = 'all of us together'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, casual question. やるの？ = 'are we doing it?'
